analysisGuideTitle: Hazard Analysis Guide for 9 High-Risk Operations

01.title: General & Common Safety
01.f: Unconfirmed worker health or psychological instability
01.m: Check blood pressure and alcohol consumption via TBM

02.title: Working at Heights
02.f: Worker falling from platform edges or openings
02.m: Strictly enforce full-body harness and lifeline usage

03.title: Hot Work
03.f: Fire/explosion of nearby combustibles from welding sparks
03.m: Remove combustibles, install fire blankets, assign fire watch

04.title: Confined Spaces
04.f: Asphyxiation/poisoning from oxygen deficiency or toxic gas
04.m: Measure gas levels before entry; operate portable ventilators continuously

05.title: Electrical Work
05.f: Electrocution due to unauthorized third-party power activation
05.m: Install LOTO (Locks & Tags) and keep keys personally

06.title: Excavation
06.f: Worker burial or equipment overturn from slope collapse
06.m: Comply with angle of repose and inspect shoring structures

07.title: Heavy Equipment
07.f: Collision/crushing of pedestrians in blind spots
07.m: Assign dedicated spotters and check rear cameras/sensors

08.title: Material Handling
08.f: Load dropping/striking due to rigging failure
08.m: Inspect rigging wear and utilize tag lines

09.title: Flammable Gas
09.f: Ignition/explosion of leaking gas during pipe pressure tests
09.m: Apply anti-static measures and inspect closely with detectors
